Case: ACC-2086 (Juniper Plan)

Status: Benefit verification is incomplete because the member identifier on the submitted Juniper Plan insurance card is unreadable. The office previously reported the card image is blurry and offered to check the member number, but no corrected identifier or new card receipt is recorded.

Requested action for office: Please provide either (1) a legible copy of the Juniper Plan insurance card via your established secure channel, or (2) the confirmed member identifier exactly as it appears on the card through that same secure channel. Once we have a legible card or confirmed identifier, benefit verification can be submitted and recorded. Note this is an administrative step and is not a coverage, prior-authorization, or clinical determination.

Notes: Do not promise a completion date. After the office provides legible member/plan details we will record returned benefit information and its date before discussing next steps.
